_comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-soroban-lints.py. Fn-rule entries map fn name -> justification. unwrap-storage-get is a ratchet baseline (fn name -> max allowed count); never raise it, regenerate with --update-baseline after removing call sites.

missing-require-initialized.get_withdrawal_eligibility: Read-only view that deliberately returns reason=not_initialized instead of reverting, so UIs can render pre-init state.

missing-require-auth.touch_user_ttl: Permissionless keeper TTL bump; only writes the caller's rate-limit bucket and extends TTL, no balance change.
missing-require-auth.preview_deposit_to_shares: Read-only preview; the only write is the global preview rate-limit bucket.
missing-require-auth.preview_shares_to_assets: Read-only preview; the only write is the global preview rate-limit bucket.
missing-require-auth.preview_withdraw: Read-only preview; the only write is the global preview rate-limit bucket.
missing-require-auth.convert_to_shares: Read-only conversion; the only write is the global preview rate-limit bucket.
missing-require-auth.convert_to_assets: Read-only conversion; the only write is the global preview rate-limit bucket.
